stories.h: VDM praised as Oyo corps members finally receive delayed allowance
stories.p: Oyo State Batch 25C corps members have reportedly received their delayed final ₦77,000 allowance, two days after VeryDarkMan raised the alarm. He shared a video of a corps member celebrating the payment.
body: Corps members of the Oyo State Batch 25C have reportedly received their long-delayed final allowance, after social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM), whose real name is Martins Vincent Otse, publicly called out the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC).
## What happened
On Wednesday, 18 November 2026, VDM shared a video on Instagram showing a corps member celebrating after receiving a credit alert and thanking him for taking up the matter.
## How it started

VDM first raised the issue on 16 November, after receiving messages from more than 100 affected corps members. He said they had completed their service and attended their passing-out parade at the end of October, but had not been paid their final ₦77,000 allowance. He called on the NYSC Director-General to act.
## How people reacted
Many social media users praised the activist for taking up the corps members' complaint.
more: The corps members were owed ₦77,000 each.
VDM raised the alarm on 16 November.
Payment came two days later.

stories.h: Nigerian stock market loses ₦2.27 trillion in one day
stories.p: Investors lost about ₦2.27 trillion on the Nigerian Exchange on Tuesday as the All-Share Index fell 1.38%. Trading volume and deals also dropped.
body: The Nigerian stock market closed sharply lower on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, as sell-offs in major stocks wiped about ₦2.27 trillion off market value in a single trading session.
## The numbers

Data from the Nigerian Exchange (NGX) showed the All-Share Index fell by 3,491.13 points, or 1.38%, to close at 249,318.65, down from 252,809.78 in the previous session. Total market capitalisation dropped by the same percentage, from ₦164.15 trillion to ₦161.88 trillion.
## Trading activity
Activity also slowed. Investors traded 564.04 million shares, down 16.26% from 673.6 million in the previous session, while the number of deals fell by 18.91% to 30,992.
## Bright spots
The losses were partly cushioned by buying interest in consumer goods and insurance stocks, with Cadbury Nigeria among the top gainers.
more: The All-Share Index fell 1.38%.
Market value dropped to ₦161.88 trillion.
Consumer goods and insurance stocks held up.

stories.h: MTN launches MTN One TV streaming service with Nigerian original series
stories.p: MTN has introduced MTN One TV, an ad-supported streaming platform to compete with Netflix and others. Its first original is a Nigerian series, 100 Ways to Stay Single in Lagos.
body: Telecommunications giant MTN has launched MTN One TV, an advertising-supported streaming service aimed at African audiences, as it takes on global platforms such as Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV.
## The platform
The service is designed to give viewers access to local entertainment and original productions, and is expected to eventually include free-to-air television channels.
## The first original
MTN has unveiled 100 Ways to Stay Single in Lagos, a Nigerian-produced series featuring actors from Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. It is the platform's first original series.
## Why it matters
The move signals MTN's ambition to become more than a mobile network provider, as competition for viewers in Africa's growing streaming market increases.
more: The service will be ad-supported.
Its first original is 100 Ways to Stay Single in Lagos.

stories.h: NCC gives MTN, Airtel and others until 31 December to use idle spectrum or lose it
stories.p: The Nigerian Communications Commission has told telecom operators to prove they are using their allocated spectrum by 31 December 2026 or risk losing it. It wants better network quality for subscribers.
body: The Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC) has given telecommunications operators, including MTN and Airtel, until 31 December 2026 to show they are effectively using their allocated spectrum or risk having it taken back.
## What spectrum is

Spectrum refers to the radio frequencies operators use to carry calls, internet data and other wireless services. Because it is a limited national resource, the regulator wants to make sure allocations are supporting real network deployment.
## Why the NCC is acting
The directive is aimed at ensuring valuable frequencies are not left idle while many Nigerians complain of poor network quality, congestion and limited broadband coverage.
## What operators must do

Under the directive, operators must show that their assigned frequencies are being actively used through investment in network infrastructure and improved services. Unused spectrum could be reclaimed and reassigned.
more: The deadline is 31 December 2026.
Unused spectrum could be reclaimed.
The aim is to improve network quality.

stories.h: FG plans 167 new CNG stations, sets gas price at ₦430
stories.p: The federal government has unveiled plans for 167 compressed natural gas refuelling stations across Nigeria to give motorists a cheaper alternative to petrol. A CNG price of ₦430 was highlighted.
body: The federal government has unveiled plans to build 167 compressed natural gas (CNG) refuelling stations across Nigeria, as part of efforts to make cheaper transport fuel more widely available and reduce dependence on petrol.
## The plan
A presentation on the initiative reportedly highlighted a CNG price of ₦430, alongside plans to expand refuelling infrastructure and tackle challenges facing the sector.
## Who benefits
The new stations are expected to improve access to CNG for motorists, especially commercial transport operators looking for alternatives to petrol, whose price has remained high.
more: 167 new CNG stations are planned.
A CNG price of ₦430 was highlighted.
The plan targets commercial transport operators.

stories.h: Osimhen's agent denies Man City want him to replace Haaland
stories.p: Victor Osimhen's representative has reportedly denied claims that Manchester City are eyeing the Super Eagles striker as a replacement for Erling Haaland. The report had suggested City would pay €75 million.
body: Victor Osimhen's agent has reportedly denied claims that Manchester City are lining up the Nigerian striker as a possible replacement for Erling Haaland.
## The claim

A Spanish report had claimed City would be prepared to pay €75 million for the Super Eagles forward if Haaland left the club. The figure matches what Galatasaray paid Napoli to sign Osimhen permanently in 2025.
## The denial
Turkish media later carried a firm rebuttal from the player's representative, dismissing the reports.
## Background

The speculation came as Manchester City face possible punishment from the Premier League over alleged breaches of financial rules, with sanctions reportedly including relegation. Some reports have suggested this could lead to the departure of top players such as Haaland.
Osimhen, who plays for Galatasaray, missed Nigeria's recent AFCON qualifiers through injury.
more: A report claimed City would pay €75 million.
His agent has rejected the claim.
Osimhen plays for Galatasaray.

stories.h: Petrol prices fall at filling stations after Dangote cuts rate by ₦51
stories.p: Major marketers including AA Rano, NIPCO and AP Ardova have reportedly reduced pump prices to between ₦1,350 and ₦1,385 per litre. It follows a ₦51 per litre cut by Dangote Refinery.
body: Motorists are beginning to see some relief at filling stations as major marketers reduce petrol prices following a ₦51 per litre cut by the Dangote Petroleum Refinery.
## The new prices

A market survey on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, reportedly showed that AA Rano, the Nigerian Independent Petroleum Company (NIPCO) and AP Ardova had lowered their petrol prices to between ₦1,350 and ₦1,385 per litre. Several filling stations are said to have cut prices by between ₦20 and ₦60 per litre, with NNPC and other marketers also adjusting their rates.
## Why prices are falling

The reductions come as the cost of importing petrol has dropped, with the landing cost of imported fuel reportedly falling to about ₦1,067 per litre, below Dangote Refinery's own rate. This has put pressure on local prices.
The survey suggested more stations could follow with price cuts in the coming days.
more: Dangote cut its petrol price by ₦51 per litre.
Prices now range from about ₦1,350 to ₦1,385.
Import costs have also dropped.

stories.h: Paul Okoye celebrates birthday without twin Peter for the first time
stories.p: P-Square's Paul Okoye marked his birthday on 18 November alone for the first time, after his twin brother Peter adopted 30 November as his new official birthday. Fans reacted with sadness over the split.
body: Paul Okoye, the singer known as Rudeboy, celebrated his birthday on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, without his twin brother Peter for the first time.
## The celebration
The P-Square star shared a video of himself sitting alone at a dining table filled with food, with a caption expressing gratitude and pride.
## Why they are apart

The solo celebration follows Peter Okoye's announcement in April 2026 that he would no longer share their birth date. Peter, who performs as Mr P, said on X that 30 November would now be his official birthday, describing it as a personal decision and thanking fans for understanding.
## How fans reacted
The birthday post drew many reactions, with numerous fans expressing sadness that the twins, who rose to fame together as P-Square, now mark their birthdays separately.
more: Peter now celebrates on 30 November.
Paul shared a video of himself dining alone.

stories.h: Moses Bliss and wife share romantic night-out video amid marriage rumours
stories.p: Gospel singer Moses Bliss and his wife Marie have shared a video of a romantic evening together, which fans see as a response to rumours of trouble in their marriage.
body: Gospel singer Moses Bliss and his wife, Marie Wiseborn Bliss, have shared a video of a romantic night out, which many fans see as a response to rumours about their marriage.
## The video

The clip, posted on Moses Bliss's Instagram page on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, showed the couple leaving an upscale restaurant in the evening. He wore a black tuxedo and bow tie, while she wore a fitted red dress. He helped her into a waiting car as they left. The post was captioned with a single word, serenity.

Unverified stories about trouble in the couple's marriage have circulated on social media several times. Neither of them had directly addressed the claims, but fans took the video as a quiet way of shutting them down.

stories.h: Flamingos coach Busari nominated for CAF Women's Coach of the Year
stories.p: Akeem Busari, who led the Flamingos to the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup title, has been nominated for CAF Women's Coach of the Year. The awards take place on 2 December.
body: Flamingos head coach Akeem Busari has been nominated for the CAF Women's Coach of the Year award after leading Nigeria to victory at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup in Morocco.
## The shortlist

Busari is one of 10 coaches on the shortlist. Others include Algeria's Farid Benstiti, Cameroon's Valentine Nguele, Ghana's Kim Lars Bjorkegren, Morocco's Jorge Vilda, South Africa's Desiree Ellis and Tanzania's Bakari Nyundo Shime, as well as Silveria Nedio of Cabo Verde, Lovemore Fazili of Malawi and Hicham Drissi of Moroccan club AS FAR.
## His achievement
Busari guided the Flamingos to Nigeria's first U-17 Women's World Cup title, making them the first African team to win the competition after beating Japan 2-1 in the final.
## When the winners are announced
The 2026 CAF Awards will take place on Wednesday, 2 December, at the Professor Wole Soyinka Centre for Culture and the Arts.
more: He led Nigeria to its first U-17 Women's World Cup title.
Nine other coaches are on the shortlist.
The CAF Awards hold on 2 December.

stories.h: CBN approves new non-interest bank, Milestone Global Bank
stories.p: The Central Bank of Nigeria has reportedly given final approval to Milestone Global Bank to operate as a regional non-interest bank. It will compete with lenders such as Jaiz Bank, TAJBank and Lotus Bank.
body: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has reportedly granted final regulatory approval to Milestone Global Bank Limited to operate as a regional non-interest bank.
## The approval
The approval is said to follow the bank's compliance with regulatory requirements on minimum capital, corporate governance and non-interest banking operations.
In a statement on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, the bank said it was finalising arrangements to begin operations, and plans to serve customers through both digital platforms and physical branches.
## The competition
The new lender will compete with established non-interest banks and other alternative banking providers, including Jaiz Bank, TAJBank and Lotus Bank.
more: Milestone Global Bank will operate regionally.
It plans digital and branch services.
It joins Jaiz, TAJBank and Lotus Bank in the sector.

stories.p: Actress Anne Hathaway and her husband Adam Shulman have reportedly welcomed their third child. She was photographed with a newborn in New York.
body: Hollywood actress Anne Hathaway and her husband, jewellery designer Adam Shulman, have reportedly welcomed their third child.

The Devil Wears Prada star, 44, was photographed on 17 November 2026 walking around New York City with a friend, carrying a newborn in a baby carrier.

stories.h: DSS says it found no evidence it planned to disrupt ADC campaign in Sokoto, asks Atiku to retract or provide proof
stories.p: The Department of State Services says its internal investigation found no evidence that it planned to recruit protesters to disrupt the ADC's presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto. It has asked Atiku Abubakar to retract or clarify his allegation, or provide evidence.
body: The Department of State Services (DSS) says its investigation found no evidence that it planned to recruit protesters to disrupt the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential campaign in Sokoto.
## How it started
Earlier this month, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar accused the leadership of the DSS of recruiting protesters to disrupt the ADC's presidential campaign flag-off rally in Sokoto.
The allegation drew wide attention, and the DSS responded by ordering an investigation into the claim.
## The DSS findings
The agency now says its investigation found nothing to support the allegation that it planned to recruit protesters or disrupt the ADC campaign.
It has asked Atiku to either retract or clarify his claim, or to provide evidence that could support further investigation.
## Not the final word
It is important to note that this is the DSS's own preliminary finding. It was not an independent investigation, which means the agency effectively investigated an allegation made against itself.
Atiku has not issued a fresh public response to the DSS findings.
## Why it matters

With the 2027 elections approaching, allegations that security agencies are being used against opposition parties are likely to keep coming up. Public trust depends on such claims being properly examined, whether they turn out to be true or not.
## Over to you
Should Atiku withdraw his allegation, provide evidence, or should an independent body investigate the claim?
more: Atiku accused the DSS of plotting to disrupt the ADC's Sokoto rally.
The DSS says its probe found no evidence.
The DSS investigation was not independent.

stories.h: Kwara suspends children's hospital chief after mothers and sick children were locked out
stories.p: The Kwara State Government has suspended the chief medical director of the Children's Specialist Hospital in Ilorin, after a viral video showed mothers and sick children allegedly locked out for arriving by 7am. The board says a shortage of doctors caused a backlog.
body: The Kwara State Government has reportedly suspended the Chief Medical Director of the Children's Specialist Hospital, Centre Igboro, Ilorin, Dr Mosunmola Folorunsho, after mothers and their sick children were allegedly locked out of the hospital.
## What happened

A video that went viral showed mothers with sick children who said they had been shut out for arriving by 7am, reportedly because they had not arrived by 5:30am. Following the outrage, the Executive Secretary of the Kwara State Hospitals Management Board, Dr Abdulraheem Malik, and members of the management team made an emergency visit to the hospital.
## The government's action

In a statement on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, the board said the CMD had been suspended and given 48 hours to explain her role in the incident. She was directed to hand over to the most senior doctor at the hospital pending further directives.
## The board's explanation

The board said its findings showed the hospital had a temporary shortage of doctors, after one of the doctors scheduled for the morning shift was away at a malaria training programme. This created a backlog of patients waiting to be seen.
more: The CMD has 48 hours to respond to a query.
The board blamed a temporary shortage of doctors.
A viral video triggered the investigation.

stories.h: Ukraine strikes Crimean bridge, part of crossing collapses
stories.p: Ukraine has struck the bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, collapsing part of the road-and-rail crossing and halting road traffic. Russia also hit two major bridges in Kyiv.
body: Ukraine has struck the bridge linking Russia to the annexed Crimean peninsula, destroying part of the road-and-rail crossing and halting road traffic, according to reports on Tuesday, 17 November 2026.
## The strike

Ukraine's SBU security service said one of the bridge's metal arches and the road span beneath it had been completely destroyed. The defence ministry said the central arch and spans had collapsed and the rail section had suffered critical damage. Images released by the SBU showed rubble and a gap several dozen metres wide between sections of the bridge.
## Zelensky's message

President Volodymyr Zelensky described the strike as unprecedented and said it was a response to Russian attacks on Ukraine's infrastructure. He said Ukraine had repeatedly offered steps towards de-escalation but had been rebuffed.
## Russia's attacks

Russia also attacked two major bridges in Kyiv, disrupting travel and damaging infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital. Road traffic on the Crimean bridge was suspended, and Russian-installed officials in Crimea urged residents not to panic.
more: Part of the bridge has collapsed.
Russia also hit two bridges in Kyiv.
Road traffic across the bridge has been suspended.

stories.h: TRCN gives all teachers until end of 2027 to get licensed
stories.p: The Teachers Registration Council of Nigeria says every teacher must be certified and licensed by December 2027. Licences will have to be renewed every three years.
body: The Teachers Registration Council of Nigeria (TRCN) has given teachers across the country until December 2027 to obtain professional certification and practising licences.
## What the council said

The council's Registrar, Dr Ronke Soyombo, announced the deadline while speaking to journalists in Abuja on Tuesday, 17 November 2026. She said the council will no longer tolerate people teaching without the required credentials and is strengthening registration, licensing and qualifying examinations.
## How it works

Soyombo explained that professional certification is obtained once, while practising licences must be renewed every three years, with evidence that the teacher has taken part in continuous professional development programmes.
Education students are now required to sit the TRCN examination before completing their training, while serving teachers must also meet the requirements.
## Help for non-education graduates
The council is introducing a faster route to professional status for teachers who do not hold education degrees, so they can get the training they need before the deadline.
more: The deadline is December 2027.
Licences must be renewed every three years.
A fast-track route is planned for non-education graduates.

stories.p: President Tinubu has reportedly approved an inland dry port for Kebbi State, announcing it at an APC campaign rally in Birnin Kebbi. He also promised more road projects requested by Governor Nasir Idris.

## The announcement

Speaking to thousands of supporters at the Birnin Kebbi Stadium, the President thanked the people of the state for their support and praised Governor Nasir Idris. He is said to have approved several projects the governor had requested, including the dry port, and promised further road infrastructure for the state.
## The campaign trail
The Kebbi rally is part of the APC's presidential campaign ahead of the 16 January 2027 election.

stories.h: Lagos-bound British Airways plane veers off taxiway at Heathrow
stories.p: A British Airways Boeing 787 bound for Lagos reportedly veered off a taxiway at Heathrow, leaving its nose wheel stuck in the grass. The airline apologised to passengers for the disruption.
body: A British Airways Boeing 787 Dreamliner heading to Lagos reportedly veered off a taxiway at London's Heathrow Airport on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, leaving its nose wheel stuck in the grass.
## What happened

The incident happened at about 10:10am as the aircraft was preparing for departure. Photos from the scene showed the plane's front wheel lodged in the grass beside the paved surface. No injuries were reported.
## The airline's response

The incident disrupted the flight, and the airline had to make alternative arrangements for passengers. A British Airways spokesperson apologised to customers and said its teams were working to get them on their way as quickly as possible and were in touch with them.
## What happens next
It was not immediately clear what caused the aircraft to leave the taxiway.

stories.h: Tiger Woods to make competitive return at Hero World Challenge
stories.p: Tiger Woods will play the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas next month, his first outdoor tournament since the 2024 Open. The 15-time major champion has been held back by injuries.
body: Tiger Woods has announced that he will play at next month's Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas, his first competitive outdoor appearance since the 2024 Open Championship.
## The tournament
The 50-year-old will be part of a 20-player field for the event, which runs from 3 to 6 December. Scottie Scheffler, Justin Thomas, Xander Schauffele and Rickie Fowler are also due to play.
## Long road back

Woods, a 15-time major champion, missed the cut at the 2024 Open while dealing with serious injuries, and further problems kept him away from outdoor competition for more than two years. He returned to competition at an indoor TGL match in March.
Days later, he was involved in a car crash in Florida. He later reached a plea deal, pleading guilty to reckless driving and refusing to take a test, and lost his driving licence for five years.
## What happens next
It is not yet clear whether Woods plans to play a wider schedule of tournaments after the event.
more: The event runs from 3 to 6 December.
It is his first outdoor event since the 2024 Open.

stories.h: Cyberattack hits 178 major websites, targeting crypto and older iPhones
stories.p: Hackers reportedly exploited a flaw in website platform Optimizely to plant malicious code on sites belonging to 178 organisations. The code tried to steal cryptocurrency and personal data.
body: A cyberattack on the website optimisation platform Optimizely reportedly exposed visitors to websites run by 178 organisations to malicious code designed to steal cryptocurrency and personal information.
## What happened

Security researcher Scott Helme said he identified the attack on Monday, 16 November 2026. The attackers are said to have exploited a weakness in Optimizely, a service businesses use to test and improve their websites, to insert harmful JavaScript into customer projects. The code could then reach visitors without them clicking any suspicious link.

Helme reportedly found 188 infected scripts linked to 178 organisations. Websites linked to well-known names including CNN, the BBC, Zoom, HSBC, IKEA, Salesforce and Equifax were among those said to be affected.
## What the code did

Researchers said the code tried to swap cryptocurrency payment addresses for wallets controlled by the attackers, capture card details, steal browser cookies, take screenshots and target security weaknesses in older Apple devices.
more: 178 organisations' websites were affected.
The code targeted crypto payments and card details.
Older Apple devices were also targeted.

stories.h: Political violence: Jonathan sounds alarm, Senate asks INEC to disqualify violent candidates as APC and ADC trade blame
stories.p: Former President Goodluck Jonathan warned that some campaigns are being run like cult groups, while the Senate urged police to probe recent attacks and INEC to disqualify candidates linked to violence. The APC accused the ADC and NDC of sponsoring violence, a claim the ADC rejected.
body: Concern over violence ahead of the 2027 elections dominated political discussion on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, with a former president, the Senate and the main parties all weighing in.
## Jonathan's warning

Speaking at a peace and security conference organised by his foundation in Abuja, former President Goodluck Jonathan warned that rising political intolerance and violence could threaten the elections. He said some political groups were running their campaign teams like cult groups, and that Nigerians at home and abroad had expressed fears about possible crises after the polls. He also condemned thuggery and the use of young people as tools of violence.
## The Senate's resolution

The Senate, acting on a motion by Senator Abdul Ningi (ADC, Bauchi Central), condemned recent attacks on political figures. These included the stoning of President Bola Tinubu's motorcade after Friday prayers in Abuja, reported attacks on NDC candidate Peter Obi in Edo State, a disrupted NDC procession in Asaba on 7 November that left one person dead, and an attack on ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar's convoy in Sokoto.

Lawmakers asked the Inspector-General of Police to carry out impartial investigations and prosecute those responsible, and urged INEC to apply the law disqualifying candidates linked to electoral violence. The motion was seconded by Senator Ali Ndume (APC, Borno South).
## APC and ADC trade accusations

The APC presidential campaign council, through its spokesperson Dele Alake, accused the ADC and NDC of sponsoring violence, deepfakes and hired protests to damage President Tinubu's campaign, pointing to the convoy incident in Abuja.

The ADC campaign council, through Phrank Shaibu, dismissed the claim as a distraction from the government's economic record. It challenged the APC to provide evidence or withdraw the allegation, and asked why no one had been prosecuted if the ruling party had proof. The NDC's response was not included in the reports.
## The chants
The APC statement also blamed the opposition for youths chanting "Tinubu Must Go" and the Hausa phrase "Ba mayi", meaning roughly "we are not supporting you", at some of the ruling party's rallies.
## What happens next
The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Jonathan says some campaigns are run like cult groups.
The Senate wants INEC to disqualify candidates linked to violence.

stories.h: Tinubu asks Senate to decriminalise attempted suicide
stories.p: President Tinubu has sent a bill to the Senate that would remove criminal penalties for attempted suicide and replace them with medical and psychological support. The National Mental Health Amendment Bill was read during plenary.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly asked the Senate to decriminalise attempted suicide and put in place medical and psychological support for survivors instead of punishment.
## The bill

The proposal is contained in the National Mental Health Amendment Bill, 2026, which Senate President Godswill Akpabio read during plenary on Tuesday, 17 November 2026. It seeks to amend the National Mental Health Act of 2021 by removing criminal liability for attempted suicide, which currently attracts prison terms under Nigeria's Criminal and Penal Codes, and replacing it with a public health approach.

In his letter to the Senate, the President urged lawmakers to give the bill quick consideration, saying it was designed to decriminalise attempted suicide and support anyone who tries to take their own life.
## Why it matters
If passed, the law would treat attempted suicide as a health issue requiring care and treatment rather than a crime.
## Getting help
Anyone who is struggling or thinking about suicide is encouraged to speak to someone they trust or contact a health professional or local support service.
more: The bill would remove prison terms for attempted suicide.
It replaces punishment with medical and psychological support.
Tinubu asked the Senate to act quickly.

stories.h: Olympic Eagles beat DR Congo 4-0 to overturn first-leg deficit
stories.p: Nigeria's U23 team beat DR Congo 4-0 in Ikenne to overturn a 2-0 first-leg loss and reach the final round of U23 qualifying. They will now face Zambia.
body: Nigeria's under-23 team, the Olympic Eagles, beat the Democratic Republic of Congo 4-0 at the Remo Stars Stadium in Ikenne to reach the final round of qualifying for the U23 Africa Cup of Nations.
## The comeback

The win was all the more impressive because Nigeria had lost the first leg 2-0 in Lubumbashi four days earlier. Alex Oweilayefa opened the scoring in the eighth minute after the DR Congo goalkeeper spilled a powerful shot from Umar Abubakar.

The home side kept up the pressure, with Saleh Sadiq denied by a goal-line clearance before half-time and Abubakar missing a close-range chance, leaving the tie level on aggregate at the break. Nigeria pulled away in the second half to win 4-0 on the day.
## What happens next
The Olympic Eagles will face Zambia in the final round of qualifying.
## Bright spot
The result came on the same day the Super Eagles were held to a goalless draw by Tanzania in their AFCON 2027 qualifier.
more: Nigeria had lost the first leg 2-0.

stories.h: US loses measles elimination status after more than a year of spread
stories.p: The Pan American Health Organization says measles is no longer eliminated in the United States, after the virus spread continuously for over a year. More than 5,400 US cases have been recorded this year.
body: The United States has lost the measles elimination status it held since 2000, after a commission of the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) found that the virus had been spreading continuously in the country for more than a year.
## The decision

PAHO announced the decision on Tuesday, 17 November 2026. The commission also found that measles was no longer eliminated in Mexico and Bolivia. PAHO's director, Dr Jarbas Barbosa, said it means the virus has circulated for a long time, putting families at risk of a preventable illness, hospitalisation and death.
## The numbers

More than 5,400 measles cases have been recorded in the US this year, more than twice last year's total and the highest since 1991. State health departments have reported 10 deaths, including at least four babies too young for routine vaccination.
## Reaction
A US public health leader, Dr Richard Besser, described the loss of elimination status as a distressing setback.
more: The US had held elimination status since 2000.
Over 5,400 cases recorded this year.
Mexico and Bolivia also lost their status.

stories.h: Super Eagles held 0-0 by Tanzania, AFCON 2027 hopes take a hit
stories.p: Nigeria were held to a goalless draw by Tanzania in Zanzibar in their AFCON 2027 qualifier, missing the chance to move to nine points. Tolu Arokodare hit the post in the first half, and coach Eric Chelle admitted afterwards that the team is in trouble.
body: Nigeria's Super Eagles were held to a 0-0 draw by Tanzania at the Amaan Stadium in Zanzibar on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, a result that reportedly dents their hopes in 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying Group L.
## The match

Nigeria went into the game knowing a win would take them to nine points and put pressure on the group leaders, Guinea-Bissau. Despite having long spells of possession, they could not break down a well-organised Tanzanian side.

Their best chance came in the 33rd minute, when Moses Usor set up Tolu Arokodare, whose close-range shot hit the post. Calvin Bassey fired over five minutes later, while Tanzania also struck the woodwork in the 42nd minute. Coach Eric Chelle made changes just after the hour, but the breakthrough never came.
## After the game

Chelle reportedly admitted after the match that the team is now in trouble in the qualifying race. Nigeria had won the first leg 3-1 in Uyo, but the draw means they missed the chance to move above Guinea-Bissau.
## Background
The game came a day after Chelle clashed with a journalist over his tactics at the pre-match press conference. Nigeria were without injured forwards Ademola Lookman and Victor Osimhen.

Nigeria missed the chance to move above Guinea-Bissau.

stories.h: Nigeria and South Africa hold talks after Fani-Kayode diplomatic row
stories.p: Nigeria and South Africa have held talks in Pretoria over tensions following a public dispute involving Nigeria's ambassador, Femi Fani-Kayode. South Africa had summoned the envoy over his conduct after he presented his credentials.
body: Nigeria and South Africa have held talks to ease tensions in their relationship, days after a public dispute involving Nigeria's ambassador to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, and officials of the South African government.
## The summons

South Africa's Department of International Relations and Cooperation (DIRCO) summoned the envoy over his conduct following the presentation of his credentials. The row followed Fani-Kayode's complaint about being left out of a presidential livestream, which drew a response from the South African presidency.
## The meeting

Fani-Kayode shared the outcome of the meeting on his X account, posting a clip of himself at DIRCO's head office in Pretoria. He said both sides raised concerns about the state of relations and the events that sparked the controversy.
He said the two countries look forward to building on the meeting and strengthening their long-standing bilateral ties.
more: South Africa summoned the envoy over his conduct.
The row began over a presidential livestream.
Both sides say they want stronger ties.

stories.h: Senate Chief Whip Monguno and APC leaders reportedly escape Boko Haram attack in Borno
stories.p: Senate Chief Whip Mohammed Tahir Monguno reportedly escaped a Boko Haram attack during a campaign tour of Kukawa, Borno State. Troops are said to have moved quickly to repel the attackers.
body: Senate Chief Whip Mohammed Tahir Monguno, who represents Borno North, has reportedly escaped a Boko Haram attack during a 2027 campaign tour of Kukawa Local Government Area of Borno State on Tuesday, 17 November 2026.
## What happened

Monguno is said to have travelled to Kukawa with former governor and senator Maina Maaji Lawan and other APC figures to campaign when the insurgents tried to overrun the area. Troops of Operation Hadin Kai, acting on intelligence, reportedly moved quickly to repel the attackers.
## The campaign tour

The APC entourage had earlier gathered in Monguno town on Sunday, where the senator joined Governor Babagana Zulum for the launch of the party's campaign in the area. The governor returned to Maiduguri by helicopter on Monday, while Monguno and others continued to Kukawa.
more: The attack happened in Kukawa, Borno State.
Troops reportedly repelled the insurgents.
The senator was on a 2027 campaign tour.

stories.h: Gombe APC chairman and campaign DG injured in road accident on way to rally
stories.p: Gombe APC chairman Mohammed Ndus and campaign director-general Sa'adu Hassan were reportedly injured in a road accident on their way to a rally in Balanga. Ndus is said to have suffered serious injuries.
body: The chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Gombe State, Mohammed Ndus, and the director-general of the party's 2027 campaign council, Sa'adu Hassan, have reportedly been injured in a road accident.
## What happened
The two officials were travelling from Gombe to join Governor Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya's convoy for a governorship campaign rally in Balanga North when the crash happened on Tuesday, 17 November 2026.
Ndus reportedly suffered serious injuries, while Hassan had minor ones. Both were taken to the Federal Teaching Hospital in Gombe for treatment.
## Official response
The Federal Road Safety Corps sector commander in Gombe, Samson Kaura, confirmed receiving information about the crash, but said he was still working to establish the full circumstances.
more: The APC chairman is said to be seriously injured.
Both men are in hospital in Gombe.
The FRSC is looking into the crash.

stories.h: ADC files 17-ground appeal against judgment that sacked its leadership
stories.p: The ADC has appealed against Justice Peter Lifu's 5 November judgment on its leadership, raising 17 grounds. It wants the Court of Appeal to stop INEC from acting on the ruling while the appeal is pending.
body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has reportedly filed an appeal against the judgment delivered by Justice Peter Lifu of the Federal High Court on 5 November 2026, which affected the party's leadership.
## The appeal

The party's Director of Strategic Communication for its presidential campaign, Phrank Shaibu, said in a statement on Tuesday, 17 November, that the appeal raises 17 grounds covering the basis, findings and orders of the judgment. These include whether the trial court had the power to hear what the party considers an internal leadership matter.
## The injunction request
The ADC is also asking the Court of Appeal to stop the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) from changing its leadership records or its candidates' details while the appeal is pending.
## Background
The ADC is fielding former Vice President Atiku Abubakar as its presidential candidate for 2027. The party also filed a separate brief against an earlier ruling made in July.
more: The appeal raises 17 grounds.
The ADC wants INEC stopped from acting on the ruling.
Atiku is the party's presidential candidate.

stories.h: Enioluwa apologises after backlash over comments on young Nigerians and work
stories.p: Influencer Enioluwa Adeoluwa has apologised after a clip from a youth conference, in which he appeared to suggest young people don't like to work, drew wide criticism. BBNaija's Nelly Mbonu was among those who pushed back.
body: Influencer Enioluwa Adeoluwa has issued a public apology after remarks he made about young Nigerians at a youth conference sparked a backlash online.
## What happened

A clip from the Emergence of Stars Port Harcourt Youth Conference showed Enioluwa making remarks that many viewers felt painted young Nigerians as unwilling to work. The video spread quickly on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, drawing criticism from people who said he ignored unemployment, systemic barriers and the economic struggles young Nigerians face.

Many critics accused him of speaking from a position of privilege. BBNaija star Nelly Mbonu was among those who publicly challenged him, rejecting the idea that young people simply choose not to work hard.
## The apology
Later the same day, Enioluwa posted a statement on X addressing the reaction, apologising for the remarks and acknowledging his privilege.
more: The clip came from a youth conference in Port Harcourt.
Nelly Mbonu was among his critics.
He has acknowledged his privilege and apologised.

stories.h: Denrele Edun announces father's death on what would have been his 85th birthday
stories.p: Media personality Denrele Edun has announced that his father, Edun Adekunle Alaba, died on 12 October after a brief illness. He shared the news on what would have been his father's 85th birthday.
body: Media personality Denrele Edun has announced the death of his father, Edun Adekunle Alaba, sharing the news on what would have been the late patriarch's 85th birthday.
## What he shared
Denrele said his father, who was born on 17 November 1941, died on Monday, 12 October 2026, after a brief illness, just weeks before the family had planned to celebrate his birthday in a big way.
## Tribute

In a moving tribute, Denrele described his father as a man whose faith was part of his everyday life, not just his Sunday routine. He was a church elder, a warden and a bass singer in the choir of the Methodist church.
With his usual humour, Denrele recalled how his father insisted that he and his siblings join the church choir, even though their singing voices were limited.
more: His father died on 12 October after a brief illness.
He would have turned 85 on 17 November.
He was a church elder and choir member.

stories.h: Tinubu announces home loans of up to ₦100m at 9.75% interest over 20 years
stories.p: President Tinubu says eligible Nigerians can get home loans of up to ₦100 million at a fixed 9.75% interest rate, repayable over 20 years. Buyers must pay at least 10% of the property's value upfront.
body: President Bola Tinubu has announced that eligible Nigerians can now access home loans of up to ₦100 million at a fixed interest rate of 9.75%, repayable over 20 years.
## How it works

In a post on his X account on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, the President reportedly said the loans are available through the ₦1 trillion MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund (MREIF). Applicants must pay a deposit of at least 10% of the property's value to qualify.
Using a ₦10 million home as an example, he said the buyer would pay ₦1 million upfront and then about ₦85,400 a month over the 20 years.
## Extra options
He added that workers in the Contributory Pension Scheme can use up to 25% of their retirement savings towards the deposit, while married couples can apply jointly to qualify for bigger loans.
## What happens next
Full eligibility rules and the application process were not detailed in the reports.
more: Loans go up to ₦100 million at 9.75% for 20 years.
Buyers need a 10% deposit.
Pension savings can cover up to 25% of the deposit.

stories.h: Defence minister says US is giving Nigeria satellite intelligence to hunt terrorist leaders
stories.p: Defence Minister Christopher Musa says the United States is providing satellite imagery, intelligence and training to help Nigeria's military track militant leaders before the 2027 elections. He said troops have killed several commanders in recent operations.
body: Nigeria's Minister of Defence, Christopher Musa, has reportedly said the United States is providing the Nigerian military with satellite imagery, intelligence and training to help locate militant leaders ahead of the 2027 general elections.
## What the minister said

Speaking to journalists on Monday, 16 November 2026, Musa said troops had killed a number of bandit and terrorist commanders in overnight operations across the north-west and north-east. He described the operations as happening almost daily and said they were backed by much better intelligence.
He said the partnership with Washington had improved the military's ability to find and strike targets.
## More equipment
The minister also said Nigeria is expecting more helicopters from the United States and Italy to support operations against insurgents in the north-east and armed bandits in the north-west.
more: The US is sharing satellite imagery and intelligence.
Troops have reportedly killed several commanders.
More helicopters are expected from the US and Italy.

stories.h: Enugu Assembly passes bill limiting rent increases
stories.p: The Enugu State House of Assembly has passed a Landlord and Tenant Amendment Bill that reportedly allows rent increases only after four years, with the increase capped. A lawmaker said it would cut what residents pay to secure accommodation by over 60%.
body: The Enugu State House of Assembly has passed the Landlord and Tenant Amendment Bill, which is meant to protect tenants from sudden and steep rent increases.
## What happened

The bill passed its third reading on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, after lawmakers considered a report by a joint committee drawn from the House committees on housing, public petitions, ethics and the judiciary.

The committee chairman, Okey Mbah, who represents Nkanu East, said the report followed wide consultation with stakeholders and that the law would end the exploitation of tenants. He said it would cut more than 60% of what residents typically pay when securing accommodation in the state.
## What the bill says
Under the bill, rent can reportedly only be raised after four years, and any increase is capped at 2%.
## What happens next
The bill is expected to go to the governor for assent before it becomes law.
more: Rent can only rise after four years.
Increases are reportedly capped at 2%.
The bill now awaits the governor's assent.

stories.h: Brymo takes a swipe at Nigeria's 'Big 3', says they are not men
stories.p: Singer Brymo has reportedly criticised Nigeria's biggest music stars, mocking what he called their reliance on their parents. He did not name anyone, but fans assumed he meant the so-called Big 3.
body: Nigerian singer Brymo has reportedly stirred debate online after taking a swipe at the country's biggest music stars, popularly known as the Big 3.
## What he said

In a statement shared on social media, Brymo is said to have questioned the maturity and independence of top artistes, mocking the idea of a grown star relying on his parents to defend him in public or travel around with him, while still claiming to be the biggest artiste in Nigeria. He ended with the line that such a person is not a man.
## No names
Brymo did not mention anyone by name, but many social media users took his comments as aimed at Davido, Wizkid and Burna Boy, who are often grouped together as the Big 3.
## How people reacted
Reactions were mixed, with some users agreeing with him and others suggesting he had a personal grudge.
more: Brymo did not name any artiste.
Fans believe he was referring to the Big 3.
Reactions online were mixed.

stories.h: Declan Rice reportedly agrees new five-year Arsenal deal
stories.p: Arsenal midfielder Declan Rice has reportedly agreed a new contract running until 2031. It would put him alongside Bukayo Saka as the club's highest-paid player.
body: Arsenal midfielder Declan Rice has reportedly agreed a new five-year contract that will keep him at the club until the summer of 2031.
## The deal
The England international is expected to sign soon. The new contract is said to put him level with Bukayo Saka as Arsenal's top earner, with Saka reportedly earning more than £350,000 a week.
Rice hinted at the deal while on international duty with England, saying a new contract was hopefully close and praising manager Mikel Arteta and his teammates for the trust they have shown in him.
## His Arsenal story

Rice joined Arsenal from West Ham in 2023 for £105 million and has become the centre of their midfield. He played 55 games last season, helping the club win the Premier League title and reach their first Champions League final since 2006, which they lost to Paris Saint-Germain.
## What happens next
Talks on the deal are said to have been going on since at least March and have now been finalised, with only the signing left.
more: The deal reportedly runs until 2031.
He would match Saka as Arsenal's top earner.
Rice joined from West Ham for £105 million in 2023.

stories.h: Iheme Nancy returns to church after four years, credits Mercy Eke
stories.p: Actress Iheme Nancy says she has gone back to church for the first time in four years, after a painful experience in 2022 made her walk away. She credited BBNaija star Mercy Eke for persuading her to attend.
body: Nollywood actress Iheme Nancy has opened up about returning to church after four years away, crediting reality TV star Mercy Eke for bringing her back.
## What she shared

In a post shared on Sunday, 15 November 2026, Nancy said a painful experience within the church in 2022, which she described as a betrayal by fellow Christians, made her walk away from her faith completely after the death of her mother.

She said Mercy Eke contacted her on Saturday and insisted that she would be attending Harvesters Church with her the next morning, promising she would not regret it. Mercy then checked on her at around 9am on Sunday to make sure she was getting ready.
## At the service

Nancy admitted she was reluctant and in a bad mood, but went anyway. She said she was flustered when Mercy walked straight to the front pews, close to the pulpit, at the church led by Pastor Bolaji Idowu.
more: She stopped attending church in 2022.
Mercy Eke took her to Harvesters Church.
She credits Mercy for bringing her back to faith.

stories.h: Sowore calls for legal cannabis, says Nigeria could earn up to ₦2.86 trillion a year
stories.p: AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore has urged the federal government to legalise, regulate and tax cannabis. He pointed to revenues in Canada and US states and projected Nigeria could earn between ₦715 billion and ₦2.86 trillion yearly.
body: African Action Congress (AAC) presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore has called on the federal government to legalise cannabis, arguing that Nigeria is missing out on billions of naira in revenue by keeping it illegal.
## What he said

In a post on X on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, Sowore said the country should build a regulated cannabis industry instead of spending resources arresting people and destroying plantations. He said he has backed legalisation since 2018.
## The figures

He pointed to regulated markets abroad, citing about CA$2.2 billion in government revenue from recreational cannabis in Canada in 2023-2024, around $1.067 billion in cannabis tax in California in 2024, and roughly $255.4 million in Colorado.

Using those examples, he projected that Nigeria could earn between $550 million and $2.2 billion a year, or about ₦715 billion to ₦2.86 trillion at an exchange rate of ₦1,300 to the dollar. He acknowledged that actual earnings would depend on how any such market is designed and run.
He also argued that legalisation could create jobs in farming, pharmaceutical production and industrial hemp, and support research and exports.
## Background
Cannabis remains illegal in Nigeria, and the NDLEA regularly carries out raids on farms and arrests dealers. Sowore, a long-time activist, is running for president in 2027 on the AAC platform.
more: Sowore says he has backed legalisation since 2018.
He projects ₦715bn to ₦2.86trn in yearly revenue.
Cannabis remains illegal in Nigeria.

stories.h: Crystal Palace appoint Thomas Frank after sacking Pierre Sage
stories.p: Crystal Palace have named former Brentford and Tottenham boss Thomas Frank as their new manager on a three-year deal. He replaces Pierre Sage, who was sacked after four months with the club bottom of the Premier League.
body: Crystal Palace have appointed Thomas Frank as their new manager, following the sacking of Pierre Sage.
## The change

Sage joined the club in the summer but was dismissed after only four months, with Palace bottom of the Premier League after 10 matches. Frank, who previously managed Brentford and Tottenham, has signed a three-year contract.
## What they said

Palace chairman Steve Parish welcomed the Dane, saying he had a proven record of building winning teams and improving players, and that his Premier League experience would help the club in the rest of the season.
Frank said it was an honour to take charge of what he called an iconic club, and that he was looking forward to meeting the players and staff.
## What happens next
His first game in charge is this weekend, when Palace travel to Coventry hoping to climb off the bottom of the table.
more: Frank has signed a three-year contract.
Palace are bottom of the Premier League.
His first game is away at Coventry.

stories.h: Fulham reportedly want £50m for Calvin Bassey as Manchester United show interest
stories.p: Fulham are reportedly asking for about £50 million for Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey amid interest from Manchester United. A sale at that price would be a club record for Fulham.
body: Fulham are reportedly ready to demand around £50 million for Nigerian international defender Calvin Bassey in the January transfer window, as Manchester United weigh a move.
## The interest

Manchester United are said to be genuinely interested in the 26-year-old, who plays mainly at centre-back but can also play at left-back, as they look to strengthen their defence for the second half of the season.

United reportedly believe a bid above £40 million would be needed to start talks, but Fulham are said to be holding out for closer to £50 million. That would beat the club's record sale, Aleksandar Mitrović's move to Al-Hilal in 2023.
## Contract situation

Bassey's contract runs until summer 2027, with Fulham holding an option to extend it by a year. Talks on a new long-term deal have reportedly moved slowly, which could leave the club open to a big offer if nothing is agreed before January.
## Background
Bassey, a former Ajax and Rangers defender, is a regular for the Super Eagles. He is reportedly open to a move to Old Trafford.
more: Fulham want close to £50 million.
His contract runs until 2027.
He is reportedly open to a move to United.

stories.h: Abia removes Kanu Nwankwo as Enyimba chairman, dissolves management and technical crew
stories.p: The Abia State Government has dissolved the management and technical crew of Enyimba FC, ending former Super Eagles captain Kanu Nwankwo's time as club chairman. The club has managed just 11 points from 13 league games this season.
body: The Abia State Government has dissolved the management and technical crew of Enyimba International FC with immediate effect, citing the club's poor performances and administrative problems.
## What the government said

In a statement on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, the state Commissioner for Information, Okey Kanu, said the decision was taken to address the club's recent disappointing results and structural challenges identified after a review of its affairs.
He said the government intends to fully restructure the club, restore its competitive identity and position it for lasting success in Nigerian and African football.
## Kanu out

The shake-up ends the tenure of former Super Eagles captain Nwankwo Kanu as chairman of the club. Enyimba have struggled badly in the 2026/2027 NPFL season, collecting only 11 points from 13 league matches.
## What happens next

The state Ministry of Sports and Youth Development has been asked to lead the restructuring, assess the club's management set-up and carry out administrative, technical and operational reforms aimed at restoring stability and accountability.
## Background
Enyimba, based in Aba, are one of Nigeria's most successful clubs and twice won the CAF Champions League. They have struggled for form this season.
more: Kanu Nwankwo is out as Enyimba chairman.
Enyimba have 11 points from 13 games.
The sports ministry will lead the restructuring.

stories.h: World Bank says 17.6 million Nigerians have benefited from NG-CARES programme
stories.p: The World Bank says more than 17.6 million Nigerians have benefited from the NG-CARES programme. It comes as the federal government continues its separate ₦50,000 relief grant.
body: The World Bank has reportedly said that more than 17.6 million Nigerians have benefited from the Nigeria Community Action Recovery and Economic Stimulus (NG-CARES) programme.
## What was said
The figure was given by the programme's World Bank task team leader, Dr Lire Ersado, at a technical meeting in Abuja on additional financing for the scheme.

He explained that NG-CARES was first set up to soften the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, but has since grown to respond to other emergencies, including the 2022 floods. It supports social protection, food security, farming, small businesses and the strengthening of institutions.
## The ₦50,000 grant

The update comes as the federal government continues a separate ₦50,000 relief grant for vulnerable Nigerians, part of wider efforts to help low-income households and small businesses cope with the rising cost of living.
more: NG-CARES began as a COVID-19 response.
It also responded to the 2022 floods.
FG is running a separate ₦50,000 grant.

stories.h: Fountain of Life trustees name interim leader, insist Jimmy Odukoya is out as senior pastor
stories.p: The Fountain of Life Church's board of trustees has named Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim leader and directed Jimmy Odukoya to vacate the senior pastor's office. A statement on the church's official page earlier rejected the removal as coming from a faction.
body: There is confusion at The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, after an announcement that Jimmy Odukoya had been removed as senior pastor was quickly rejected by the church and by Odukoya himself.
## The removal announcement

On Tuesday, 17 November 2026, a statement presented as coming from the church's board of trustees said Jimmy's tenure did not reflect the succession wishes of his late father and the church's founder, Taiwo Odukoya, who died in 2023. It said the board had reviewed the church's constitution and recordings of the founder's wishes, and that Jimmy was no longer recognised as senior pastor with immediate effect. The statement described the decision as a governance matter and not a personal judgement.
## The church's response

Within hours, a statement posted on the church's official Instagram page and on Jimmy Odukoya's page rejected the announcement as having no constitutional weight. It said the announcement did not come from a properly constituted meeting of the Board of Trustees, but from a faction calling itself "Concerned Members of the Board".

The church said the individuals behind the faction had been formally asked to step down from the board on 14 March 2026 over what it described as repeated violations of the church's constitution and founding principles, and that the letter had been delivered to and acknowledged by them.
## The founder's video

Later on Tuesday, a video said to have been recorded by the late Taiwo Odukoya in December 2021 emerged, with a transcript released by the board of trustees. In it, he reportedly named Pastor Kunle Areogun as the person who should lead the church if he died or was unable to continue.

He is said to have stated that Jimmy should serve as Areogun's immediate administrative assistant and lead the youth church. The video was reportedly recorded by Jimmy at his father's request and witnessed by his older brother, Pastor John Odukoya, and it has now become central to the dispute.
## Interim leader named

Later on Tuesday, the board of trustees appointed Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim spiritual and administrative leader of the church. It said its resolution of 16 November removing Jimmy Odukoya remained in force and directed him to vacate the office and all its responsibilities. The trustees said Jimmy was present when his father's 2021 video was recorded.
## Social media dispute

The trustees have also accused Jimmy Odukoya of taking control of the church's official social media accounts without approval and using them to share what they called misleading statements. They told members and the public to treat only statements signed on the board's behalf as authentic, and said they were taking steps to recover the accounts. Jimmy Odukoya had not responded to that claim in the reports.
## Background

Jimmy Odukoya, an actor and pastor, took over leadership of the church after his father's death. On 1 November he remarried and presented his new wife to the congregation. A video of the late founder said to show the role he intended for his son has also been circulating online amid the dispute.
## What happens next
It is not yet clear how the leadership dispute will be resolved. The faction behind the removal announcement had not responded publicly to the church's statement in the reports.
more: Trustees named Pastor Rotimi Okpaise interim leader.
They told Jimmy Odukoya to vacate the office.
A statement on the church's page had called the removal invalid.

stories.h: No NIN, no flight: FG sets 1 January deadline for domestic air passengers
stories.p: Passengers without a valid National Identification Number will be refused boarding on domestic flights from 1 January 2027. Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo announced the rule while unveiling a new passenger verification system.
body: The federal government has announced that passengers without a valid National Identification Number (NIN) will not be allowed to board domestic flights from 1 January 2027.
## The new system

Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development Festus Keyamo announced the policy while unveiling the Verified Passenger Authentication System (VPASS), a digital platform that links passengers' identities directly to their NIN records.
Keyamo said the system will help authorities confirm genuine passengers, prevent unauthorised access to restricted airport areas and make sure airline passenger lists are accurate.
## Why it is being introduced

The minister pointed to irregularities in ticket sales, including bulk buying and reselling of tickets under different identities, as problems the government wants to stop. He said tying bookings to verified identity records would make it harder for anyone to travel using false details.
## What airlines must do
Keyamo directed the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority (NCAA) to ensure that domestic airlines connect to the platform before 31 December 2026, ahead of the January deadline.
## What it means for travellers
Anyone planning to fly within Nigeria in the new year will need to make sure their NIN is valid and matches the details they use to book tickets.
more: The rule starts on 1 January 2027.
Airlines must link up to the VPASS system by 31 December.
It aims to stop ticket fraud and fake identities.
